effects.description: Turn right on empty, left on filled, flip, step: then a highway
effects.descriptionZh: 空格右转，填格左转，翻转再前进：然后是一条高速公路

effects.title: Falling sand
effects.description: Cellular automaton: grains fall, slide diagonally, water spreads sideways
effects.descriptionZh: 元胞自动机：沙粒下落、斜向滑动，水向两侧铺开

effects.title: Doom fire
effects.description: The PlayStation Doom fire: copy heat up, jitter sideways, cool randomly
effects.descriptionZh: PlayStation 版 Doom 火焰：热量上移、左右抖动、随机冷却

effects.title: Water ripples
effects.description: Height-field wave equation on the GPU, refracting a grid beneath
effects.descriptionZh: GPU 上的高度场波动方程，折射水下的网格

effects.title: Double pendulums
effects.description: Chaos: pendulums a fraction of a milliradian apart diverge completely
effects.descriptionZh: 混沌：相差不到一毫弧度的双摆最终完全分道扬镳

effects.title: N-body orbits
effects.description: Every body pulls every other; leapfrog integration keeps orbits closed
effects.descriptionZh: 每个天体吸引其余所有天体；蛙跳积分让轨道保持闭合

effects.title: Vortex drain
effects.description: Lamb–Oseen vortex plus inflow; differential rotation winds colour into arms
effects.descriptionZh: Lamb–Oseen 涡加向心流；差速旋转把颜色卷成旋臂

effects.title: Plexus
effects.description: Drifting points linked by distance-faded lines, found through a grid
effects.descriptionZh: 漂移的点以随距离淡出的线相连，借助网格查找邻居

effects.title: Lenia
effects.description: Ring-kernel convolution and a growth bump: Chan’s Lenia, four species
effects.descriptionZh: 环形核卷积加生长钟形曲线：Chan 的 Lenia，四个物种

effects.title: Differential growth
effects.description: Repel, align, split stretched edges: a growing line folds to fit
effects.descriptionZh: 排斥、对齐、拉长的边一分为二：不断生长的线只能折叠

effects.title: Snowflake growth
effects.description: Gravner–Griffeath model: vapour diffuses, sites freeze by neighbour rules
effects.descriptionZh: Gravner–Griffeath 模型：水汽扩散，按邻居规则逐格冻结

effects.title: Mud cracks
effects.description: Warped Voronoi walls tear open as the drying front passes
effects.descriptionZh: 扭曲的沃罗诺伊边界随干燥前沿逐一裂开

effects.title: Digital rain
effects.description: Falling glyph heads with fading tails, stamped from a cached atlas
effects.descriptionZh: 下落的字符头拖着渐隐尾迹，从缓存图集中盖印

effects.title: Warp starfield
effects.description: Perspective-projected stars whose streak length grows with speed
effects.descriptionZh: 透视投影的星星，拖影长度随速度增长

effects.title: Oscilloscope
effects.description: X-Y Lissajous beam with speed-dependent brightness and phosphor afterglow
effects.descriptionZh: X-Y 李萨如光束，亮度随速度变化并带荧光余辉

effects.title: Copper bars
effects.description: Per-scanline colour ramps on a rolling drum, in 12-bit colour
effects.descriptionZh: 滚筒上逐扫描线的颜色渐变，12 位色

effects.title: Checker tunnel
effects.description: Angle and inverse radius as texture coordinates; a flat checker becomes a tube
effects.descriptionZh: 以角度和半径倒数作纹理坐标，平面棋盘变成管道

effects.title: Rotozoom
effects.description: One texture lookup through a rotating, breathing scale matrix
effects.descriptionZh: 通过旋转并呼吸缩放的矩阵做一次纹理查找

effects.title: Seven-segment clock
effects.description: Bevelled hexagon segments with lit glow and unlit ghosts
effects.descriptionZh: 斜切六边形段，点亮发光，未亮留影

effects.title: LED dot-matrix sign
effects.description: 5×7 bitmap text stepped one LED column at a time, bloomed per LED
effects.descriptionZh: 5×7 位图文字逐列步进，每颗 LED 独立泛光

effects.title: Radar sweep
effects.description: Phosphor decay as exp(−angle since the beam passed)
effects.descriptionZh: 荧光衰减 = exp(−波束扫过后转过的角度)

effects.title: Heart monitor
effects.description: Gaussian PQRST beats written in place behind an erase bar
effects.descriptionZh: 高斯 PQRST 心搏原地写入，前方擦除条开路

effects.title: Spectrum analyser
effects.description: Synthesised spectrum, fast-attack bars, peak caps falling under gravity
effects.descriptionZh: 合成频谱，快升慢落的光柱，峰值帽受重力下落

effects.title: Neon tubes
effects.description: Hot core, coloured glass, and a mip-pyramid bloom
effects.descriptionZh: 炽热灯芯、彩色玻璃管与 mip 金字塔泛光

effects.title: Targeting HUD
effects.description: Spring-damped reticle, edge rulers, and brackets that close to lock
effects.descriptionZh: 弹簧阻尼准星、边缘标尺，括号收拢即锁定

effects.title: Fade & scale in
effects.description: Cards rise from 94% scale, never from zero
effects.descriptionZh: 卡片从 94% 的大小升起，而不是从零开始

effects.title: Stagger grid
effects.description: Delay grows with distance from the tap
effects.descriptionZh: 延迟随与点击处的距离增长

effects.title: Easing curves race
effects.description: Same distance, same time, four easing curves
effects.descriptionZh: 同样距离、同样时长、四种缓动曲线

effects.title: 3D card flip
effects.description: rotateY on a spring, with the back face hidden
effects.descriptionZh: 弹簧驱动 rotateY，并隐藏背面

effects.title: Anticipation & follow-through
effects.description: Crouch before the hop, wobble after the landing
effects.descriptionZh: 起跳前先下蹲，落地后再晃动

effects.title: List reorder (FLIP)
effects.description: FLIP reorder; rising rows pass above falling ones
effects.descriptionZh: FLIP 重排；上升的行从下降的行上方经过

effects.title: Add & remove
effects.description: The gap closes after the item leaves, and opens before it returns
effects.descriptionZh: 项目离开后空隙才合拢，回来前空隙先张开

effects.title: Number ticker
effects.description: Each digit is a 0–9 strip that rolls to its value
effects.descriptionZh: 每一位数字都是一条 0–9 的长条，滚动到对应数值

effects.title: Accordion FAQ
effects.description: Height to a measured value, text a beat later
effects.descriptionZh: 高度过渡到测量值，文字晚一拍出现

effects.title: Tab swap
effects.description: A clipped copy of the tabs; the leading edge moves first
effects.descriptionZh: 一份被裁剪的标签副本；前沿先动

effects.title: Push slide
effects.description: The new screen pushes; the old one drifts slower
effects.descriptionZh: 新页面推入，旧页面移动得更慢

effects.title: Circle reveal
effects.description: A clip-path circle grows from the tap point

effects.description: Bars cover in a stagger, the page swaps unseen

effects.title: Shared-element expand
effects.description: FLIP with a uniform scale and a clip
effects.descriptionZh: FLIP 配合等比缩放和裁剪

effects.title: View Transitions morph
effects.description: The browser morphs matching view-transition-names
effects.descriptionZh: 浏览器自动形变 view-transition-name 相同的元素

effects.title: iOS sheet
effects.description: The page steps back as the sheet comes up
effects.descriptionZh: 面板升起时，页面向后退

effects.title: Lightbox zoom
effects.description: The square crop opens out to the full photo
effects.descriptionZh: 方形裁切展开为完整照片

effects.title: Directional tabs
effects.description: Content enters from the side of the tab you picked
effects.descriptionZh: 内容从你所选标签的那一侧进入

effects.title: Blur crossfade

effects.descriptionZh: 短暂的模糊掩盖了重影

effects.descriptionZh: 拖动、盖章、甩出；卡堆弹起

effects.title: Page turn
effects.description: Each row bent from the spine in short segments, so paper never stretches
effects.descriptionZh: 每一行从书脊出发由短段连接弯曲，纸张永不拉伸

effects.title: Letter rise stagger
effects.description: Letters spring up from a clipped line, 40 ms apart
effects.descriptionZh: 字母从被裁剪的行中依次弹起，间隔 40 毫秒

effects.title: Scramble decode
effects.description: Characters churn through random glyphs, then lock left to right
effects.descriptionZh: 字符在随机字形间翻滚，再从左到右锁定

effects.title: Variable-font wave
effects.description: A sine wave rolls through variable-font weight and width
effects.descriptionZh: 一道正弦波滚过可变字体的字重和字宽

effects.title: Typewriter
effects.description: Typing with randomised keystroke delays and pauses at punctuation
effects.descriptionZh: 随机化按键间隔，遇到标点停顿

effects.title: Line mask reveal
effects.description: Lines slide up one by one from behind a clipping edge
effects.descriptionZh: 文字逐行从裁剪边缘后方滑上来

effects.title: Split-flap board
effects.description: Each character flips through the alphabet, one fold at a time
effects.descriptionZh: 每个字符逐片翻过字母表，一次翻一页

effects.title: Odometer counter

effects.descriptionZh: 数字轮滚动，进位向左传递，像里程表一样

effects.title: Rotating word
effects.description: One word cycles through a clipped slot with a slight blur
effects.descriptionZh: 一个词带着轻微模糊，在裁剪槽中轮换

effects.title: Marker highlight
effects.description: An uneven marker stroke sweeps behind key phrases
effects.descriptionZh: 一道不均匀的马克笔笔触扫过关键短语背后

effects.title: Text on a circle
effects.description: Text on an SVG circle turns, easing toward a target speed
effects.descriptionZh: SVG 圆形路径上的文字旋转，速度缓缓趋近目标值

effects.description: Type on a Möbius band, framed by parallel transport
effects.descriptionZh: 文字贴在莫比乌斯带上，用平行移动标架定向

effects.title: Parallax layers
effects.description: Layers move at speeds that fall with depth
effects.descriptionZh: 图层的移动速度随深度递减

effects.title: Scrub reveal
effects.description: Words light up one by one, scrubbed by scroll
effects.descriptionZh: 文字随滚动逐词点亮

effects.title: Pinned horizontal track
effects.description: Vertical scroll slides a sticky row sideways
effects.descriptionZh: 纵向滚动让固定的一行横向滑动

effects.title: Zoom-through

effects.descriptionZh: 指数缩放让视角穿过一个字母的字腔

effects.title: Velocity-skew marquee

effects.descriptionZh: 滚动速度让跑马灯加速并倾斜

effects.descriptionZh: 缓动的 scaleX 进度条，加上剩余阅读分钟数

effects.title: Sticky card stack

effects.descriptionZh: 粘性卡片层层堆叠，新卡到来时旧卡后退

effects.title: Timeline draw
effects.description: A scroll-scrubbed line draws down; milestones trigger as it passes
effects.descriptionZh: 随滚动擦出的线条向下延伸，经过时触发里程碑

effects.title: Image-sequence scrub

effects.descriptionZh: 滚动位置决定显示图像序列的哪一帧

effects.title: Snap gallery
effects.description: Scroll snapping; the centre card scales up, neighbours dim
effects.descriptionZh: 滚动吸附；居中卡片放大，相邻卡片变暗

effects.title: Magnetic button
effects.description: Pulled toward the cursor, label pulled further
effects.descriptionZh: 被光标吸引，标签被吸得更远

effects.title: Click ripple
effects.description: A circle expands from the exact press point
effects.descriptionZh: 一个圆从精确的按下位置扩散开

effects.title: 3D tilt card
effects.description: The card turns toward the pointer, glare follows
effects.descriptionZh: 卡片转向指针，高光随之移动

effects.title: Cursor trail
effects.description: Each point chases the one before it
effects.descriptionZh: 每个点追随前一个点

effects.title: Spotlight reveal
effects.description: A soft mask follows the cursor over a dark layer
effects.descriptionZh: 柔和的遮罩跟随光标，在深色图层上移动

effects.title: Image follow
effects.description: A preview trails the cursor and swaps per row
effects.descriptionZh: 预览图拖在光标后面，并按行切换

effects.title: Directional fill
effects.description: The fill enters and leaves the way the cursor did
effects.descriptionZh: 填充从光标进入的方向进来，从离开的方向退出

effects.title: Sliding underline
effects.description: One underline travels between links and stretches
effects.descriptionZh: 一条下划线在链接间移动并拉伸

effects.title: Lit border
effects.description: Card edges catch a light that follows the cursor
effects.descriptionZh: 卡片边缘捕捉跟随光标的光

effects.title: Dock magnify
effects.description: Icons swell around the cursor and push apart
effects.descriptionZh: 光标周围的图标膨胀并相互推开

effects.title: Toggle spring
effects.description: The knob stretches while it travels
effects.descriptionZh: 滑块在移动时被拉长

effects.title: Like burst
effects.description: Squash, pop, ring and sparks on one beat
effects.descriptionZh: 压扁、弹出、光环与火花同拍发生

effects.title: Submit to success
effects.description: The button becomes the spinner becomes the tick
effects.descriptionZh: 按钮变成加载圈，再变成对勾

effects.title: Arc spinner
effects.description: The arc grows and shrinks while it turns
effects.descriptionZh: 弧线一边旋转一边伸缩

effects.title: Skeleton shimmer
effects.description: A light sweep says loading, then content fades in
effects.descriptionZh: 一道光扫过表示正在加载，随后内容淡入

effects.title: Copy to tick
effects.description: The copy icon turns into a tick, with a Copied tag
effects.descriptionZh: 复制图标变成对勾，并出现“已复制”标签

effects.title: Password strength
effects.description: Meter and checklist update on every keystroke
effects.descriptionZh: 强度条和检查清单随每次按键更新

effects.title: Hold to delete
effects.description: Slow fill while held, fast snap back on release
effects.descriptionZh: 按住时缓慢填充，松开时快速弹回

effects.title: Bell and badge
effects.description: The bell rings, the count rolls up
effects.descriptionZh: 铃铛响起，计数向上滚动

effects.title: Toast stack
effects.description: New toasts in front, older ones step back
effects.descriptionZh: 新通知在前，旧通知向后退

effects.title: Squash & stretch bounce
effects.description: Stretch with speed, squash on impact
effects.descriptionZh: 随速度拉伸，撞击时压扁

effects.title: Rubber-band drag
effects.description: Resistance grows past the edge, release springs back
effects.descriptionZh: 越过边缘阻力渐增，松手后弹回

effects.title: Pendulum wave
effects.description: Lengths tuned so the row drifts in and out of sync
effects.descriptionZh: 调好摆长，让一排摆锤时而同步时而错开

effects.title: Verlet rope
effects.description: Points remember where they were; lengths are enforced
effects.descriptionZh: 点记得自己上一刻的位置；长度被强制约束

effects.title: Ball collisions
effects.description: Elastic impulses along the line between centres
effects.descriptionZh: 沿两球心连线方向的弹性冲量

effects.title: Snap-point bottom sheet
effects.description: Aim with the throw, then spring to the nearest snap point
effects.descriptionZh: 用甩动瞄准，再弹到最近的吸附点

effects.title: Swipe to dismiss

effects.descriptionZh: 顺着甩动飞走，反方向则橡皮筋回弹

effects.title: Chat heads
effects.description: Each bubble chases the one in front on its own spring
effects.descriptionZh: 每个气泡用自己的弹簧追随前一个

effects.title: Jelly app icon
effects.description: A second spring turns speed into stretch
effects.descriptionZh: 第二个弹簧把速度转化为拉伸

effects.title: Pull to refresh
effects.description: Rubber-band pull, hold on a shelf, spring home
effects.descriptionZh: 橡皮筋式下拉，停在搁架上，再弹回原位

effects.title: Shape morph
effects.description: Every shape is the same 160 polar radii
effects.descriptionZh: 每个形状都是同样的 160 条极坐标半径

effects.title: Icon morph
effects.description: Two icons drawn with the same points, interpolated
effects.descriptionZh: 两个图标用相同的点绘制，再做插值

effects.title: Gooey blobs
effects.description: Blur, then a hard alpha threshold
effects.descriptionZh: 先模糊，再做硬性的 alpha 阈值

effects.title: Line draw-on
effects.description: stroke-dasharray equals the path length
effects.descriptionZh: stroke-dasharray 等于路径长度

effects.title: Liquid button
effects.description: Edge points on springs, pushed by the pointer
effects.descriptionZh: 边缘的点挂在弹簧上，被指针推动

effects.title: Play to pause
effects.description: Two four-point halves of a triangle slide into two bars
effects.descriptionZh: 三角形的两个四点半边滑成两根竖条

effects.title: Menu to close

effects.descriptionZh: 三条两点线段，中间那条缩成一个点

effects.title: Chart morph
effects.description: Every dataset resampled to the same 48 points
effects.descriptionZh: 每组数据都重采样为同样的 48 个点

effects.title: Logo draw
effects.description: Dash length = path length, then slide the offset to zero
effects.descriptionZh: 虚线长度等于路径长度，再把偏移滑到零

effects.title: Button to menu
effects.description: One surface, a rounded clip-path opening from the button corner
effects.descriptionZh: 同一块表面，圆角 clip-path 从按钮所在的角展开

effects.title: Dynamic island
effects.description: One black box clipped to three springs: width, height and corner radius
effects.descriptionZh: 一个黑色方块，用三个弹簧裁出宽、高和圆角
